'''Myte''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Hive}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Myte}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Toxic Cornucopia
|Intent = StatusCard
|Effect = Adds 2 {{C2|Toxic}} to your hand.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Bite
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (13;{{Asc2|9|15}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Suck
|Intent = Attack1, Buff
|Effect = Deals (4;{{Asc2|9|6}}) damage. Gains (2;{{Asc2|9|3}}) {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Mytes always appear in pairs. One opens with {{Int2|Myte|Toxic Cornucopia}} and the other opens with {{Int2|Myte|Suck}}.

Afterward, Mytes follow a fixed pattern:
# {{Int2|Myte|Toxic Cornucopia}}
# {{Int2|Myte|Bite}}
# {{Int2|Myte|Suck}}

== Useful Cards ==
* Cards like {{C2|Fiend Fire}}, {{C2|Compact}} and {{C2|GUARDS!!!}} can get rid of all copies of {{C2|Toxic}} in hand without needing to pay their {{KW2|Energy}} cost, and also gain an additional benefit from doing so.
* Cards like {{C2|Calculated Gamble}} or {{C2|Storm of Steel}} can also get rid of {{C2|Toxic}} and gain a benefit for doing so, although this means that {{C2|Toxic}} will be drawn again once the deck is reshuffled.
